metadata.title: MapIT Verified Active Indian Startups Directory
metadata.scope: A curated, evidence-backed cohort of active, private Indian startups and India-founded scale-ups with a public product, a LinkedIn company profile, a recent launch/update or current product signal, and a current hiring signal.
metadata.exhaustiveness_note: This is not an exhaustive list of every startup in India. The Government reported more than 2.23 lakh DPIIT-recognized startups by 31 March 2026, and no single public directory simultaneously verifies product activity, launches, LinkedIn identity, and live hiring for all of them.
selection_rules: India-headquartered or India-founded with a substantial Indian product or hiring presence.
Private active startup or scale-up at the time of review; public and clearly acquired/inactive companies excluded.
Publicly accessible active product or platform.
Dated product launch/update where found; otherwise a clearly labeled current product signal.
Current hiring evidence from an official careers page, LinkedIn jobs, or the July 2026 YC India hiring directory.
metadata.refresh_recommendation: Re-check live hiring weekly and product/LinkedIn metadata every 30-60 days.
